messages.author: 1d15a1166a3152c3
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] summary() export
parts:
Hello

Dne pondělí 22. června 2020 1:37:33 CEST, 'M N' via poppr napsal(a):

> Is there any practical way to export this data into whatever
> machine-readable format? .csv? .txt sep="\t"? Others?

What about something like:

data(cars)
summary(cars)
datasumtab <- summary(cars)
datasumtab
class(datasumtab)
write.table(x=datasumtab, file="out.tsv", quote=FALSE, sep="\t")

HTH,
V.
